name: Tutorial Task: [You Can Build a Trade Unit]

civilopediaText.text: You Can Build a Trade Unit!
You've unlocked the ability to construct a [Caravan], the earliest Trade unit available. Once built, you can establish a [Trade Route] with a city in another civilization that will generate [Gold].
Although you start with the ability to create just a single [Trade Route], additional [Trade Route] slots can be earned as your civilization becomes more advanced.
